name: Public bed — topsoil 4 in + compost 4 in

items.name: Topsoil — 4 in (prototype)
items.note: User-requested prototype assumption, not a requirement verified on L1.0. Separate uniform 4-inch layer over BED-C1. CY = SF × (4/12) / 27 = SF / 81. No waste or compaction allowance.

items.name: Compost — 4 in (prototype)
items.note: User-requested prototype assumption, not a requirement verified on L1.0. Separate uniform 4-inch layer over BED-C1. CY = SF × (4/12) / 27 = SF / 81. No waste or compaction allowance.
